astranaar_moon_guard: Talonar Swiftmoon, of the Moon Guard. This tower is the north-west corner of Astranaar, and from the top of it I can see Lake Elune'ara. The moon watches over this town tonight, as it always has. The lake I am less sure of. I keep a ledger of it, and the ledger has stopped making sense.
astranaar_sentinel_commander: Sentinel Eltharaen. I command Astranaar from this hall at the north end. You are not one of ours, and three years ago I would not have let you past the gate. Ashenvale bleeds a little more each day, and I have stopped asking who is holding the bandage. Stay armed. Stay watchful.
astranaar_flight_master: The hippogryph roost, north-east corner of Astranaar. I fly the Sentinels' routes and, these days, anyone the Commander has not told me to refuse. The Strand on the coast is the far end of my line. Where do you need to go?
pt_astranaar_herbs: Elaria, apothecary. I teach herbs on the east side of Astranaar. Every weed is a medicine to someone. Ashenvale grows more of them than anywhere in Kalimdor, and I will show you which to pull and what to do with it after. The second part is where people go wrong.
pt_astranaar_wood: Shandris, woodwright. No - not that Shandris. I teach in the middle of town. We take only what has already fallen, and there is a great deal fallen now. The sawmill is by the south-east wall, beside the forge.
pt_astranaar_essence: They call me Tinker Maiev, and I have heard every joke about the name. I teach engineering east of the hall. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two and I will see about the third.
pt_astranaar_hide: Valen, tanner. My frames are in the middle of Astranaar, upwind of the inn by agreement. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - pay once and I teach the lot, cooking included. A hunter who throws the meat away has only done half the killing.
ct_astranaar: Thalanil. I train every discipline, beside the inn on the east side. I have taught Sentinels for longer than your Horde has had a name, and I have lately learned that a student is a student. Show me where you are, and bring coin.
astranaar_innkeeper: Rimble! Innkeeper. Yes, a gnome, in Astranaar - I came for a week and the roads closed behind me. The inn is on the east side of town and the beds are elf-sized, which suits nobody. Rest here a while. Ashenvale's roads are not kind after dark.
astranaar_sentinel_trainer: Drill instructor to the Sentinels. This yard is the west side of Astranaar. Form up. Ashenvale does not forgive sloppy footwork, and neither do I - I have buried too many who thought the forest would wait for them.
pt_astranaar_forge: Ilyenna. Mining and smithing, both halves or neither. I teach on the east side, a few steps up from the town forge - it is against the south-east wall, with the sawmill beside it. Bring ore.
astranaar_sentinel_liaison: Sentinel Shalasyr. Eltharaen keeps the hall standing. I keep the roads open, from this post above the south gate. Lately mine is the harder job. The furbolg of the Ragged Highlands have turned on us, and I have scouts who went up that road and did not come down it.
astranaar_refugee: Thessaly. I am staying by the south gate until they find somewhere to put us. We ran from the coast with nothing - I mean that exactly, nothing. If I could get a few things back, I could start again. If I cannot, I would at least like to stop listening for cats.
astranaar_grove_warden: Grove Warden Pennarin. I keep the south-east corner of Astranaar, and from it I keep watch on Moonwhisper Grove to the east and the Moonwell to the north. The Grove answers to no one. Lately it does not answer at all.
astranaar_druid_trainer: Kerlonian Evershade. I teach druids in the south-east of Astranaar, under the oldest tree left inside the walls. The wild whispers to those who know how to listen. It has been saying the same thing for three years now, and I do not care for it. Do you listen?
